rows.label: Pain
rows.note:
Gained 3x with every HP lost. +25 with crit or painful attacks. Lost with anestetics or sleep (-3/hour). When over 75, it lowers to 75 after hour of resting.

Passing Survival check with pain value allows you to ignore pain effects.
